title: Interactive Engagement with Technology for Humanity: IEEE Leadership, Professional Growth and Societal Impact

images.alt: Group photograph of participants with Prof. Luis G. Kun at the IEEE Hyderabad Section programme
images.caption: Participants with Prof. Luis G. Kun at the special section-level programme

content.text: This special IEEE Hyderabad Section section-level programme was an interactive engagement centered on technology for humanity, IEEE leadership, professional growth, and societal impact.

The programme featured Prof. Luis G. Kun, IEEE Life Fellow and Past President of the IEEE Society on Social Implications of Technology (SSIT), who also serves as Vice-Chair of the IEEE Fellows Committee.

content.alt: Group photograph of participants with Prof. Luis G. Kun at the IEEE Hyderabad Section programme
content.caption: Participants with Prof. Luis G. Kun at the special section-level programme

content.text: The programme was followed by networking and dinner.

description: A special IEEE Hyderabad Section interactive programme with Prof. Luis G. Kun exploring technology for humanity, IEEE leadership, professional growth, and societal impact, followed by networking and dinner.
